The Visigoths exert their revenge on Rome, attacked and sacked, but then Placidia is captured by Ataulf. Ataulf loses, and is honor bound to let Olympius free one of the women prisoners. The consul chooses Sabina, his lawful wife whom he had married for political reasons but for whom he had become in love.
